dashboard.title: This Computer
dashboard.body: Your device, its connected workspaces and its agents — create, configure, start and stop agents here.

workspaces.title: Connected Workspaces
workspaces.body: Every workspace this device has joined, with its agents and activity. Connect one from the command line with `agn connect` — a device can belong to several at once.

footnote.node: Connecting an agent to a workspace happens later, from the Agents page, with `agn connect`.
